name: Move AppLovin Data to Google Bigquery
steps:
1.  From the Data Sources section select **AppLovin** as the datasource.
2.  Select your added **Google Bigquery** data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Add API Key to add Credentials.
4.  Click on [\+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/applovin/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
